note: insert_responsive_image is an experimental style-provider submodule of Insert with NO config, route, permissions, or per-widget setting of its own. hook_insert_styles (image type) adds one insert style per ResponsiveImageStyle entity, named responsive_image__<style-id> (label 'Responsive: <id>'). hook_insert_variables (run after the parent's via hook_module_implements_alter) calls core template_preprocess_responsive_image() to build srcset/sizes and resolves the fallback image style URL. To use it you create a Responsive Image style then enable responsive_image__<id> in an image field widget's Insert settings (parent's content.<field>.third_party_settings.insert.styles). Medium/hard cases create a namespaced Responsive Image style (insert_ri_demo) and an image field on Article (two-save so image_image sticks past lightning_media_image) and check the responsive insert style key in the parent's third_party_settings.insert.styles.

evals.prompt: The Drupal insert_responsive_image submodule lets editors insert responsive images. What insert 'styles' does it add and how are they named, and does it have any settings of its own?
evals.expected_output: It implements hook_insert_styles for the image insert type and adds one insert style per Responsive Image style, named responsive_image__<style-id> (label 'Responsive: <id>'). It has no config object, route, permissions, or per-widget setting of its own; the responsive styles simply become selectable in the parent Insert module's per-widget styles list.

evals.prompt: How do I actually make a responsive image insertable on a Drupal image field using insert_responsive_image, and where does the enabled choice end up stored?
evals.expected_output: Create/enable a Responsive Image style, then on the image field's Manage form display open the Insert settings and tick the Responsive: <id> (responsive_image__<id>) style. The choice is stored by the parent Insert module in content.<field>.third_party_settings.insert.styles on the entity_form_display component.

evals.prompt: When inserting a responsive image with insert_responsive_image, which core function builds the responsive markup and which two HTML attributes does it add to the inserted ?
evals.expected_output: Its hook_insert_variables calls core template_preprocess_responsive_image() to generate the srcset and sizes attributes (using the Responsive Image style's mappings), resolves the URL from the style's fallback image style, and merges those attributes into the inserted .

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article content type has an image field whose Insert settings enable a responsive-image insert style. Inspect the live default form display for Article and give the field machine name and the exact responsive insert style key that is enabled.
evals.expected_output: The field is field_insert_ri (image_image widget); its component's third_party_settings.insert.styles contains responsive_image__insert_ri_demo (the responsive insert style for the Responsive Image style 'insert_ri_demo'), which is also its default insert style.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is a Responsive Image style with id insert_ri_demo, and the Article content type has an image field field_insert_ritask using the standard Image (image_image) widget with Insert already enabled. Using insert_responsive_image, make the responsive insert style for insert_ri_demo (responsive_image__insert_ri_demo) available on that field's Insert settings. Keep the image_image widget and apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Add responsive_image__insert_ri_demo to the field_insert_ritask image_image component's third_party_settings.insert.styles in core.entity_form_display.node.article.default (the component already exists, so a single setComponent with the added style and save is enough; or tick 'Responsive: insert_ri_demo' under Insert on the widget in Manage form display).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article content type has a second image field whose Insert settings enable a responsive-image insert style built from the Responsive Image style 'insert_ri_demo2'. Inspect the live default form display for Article and give that field's machine name and the exact responsive insert style key that is enabled.
evals.expected_output: The field is field_insert_ri2 (image_image widget); its component's third_party_settings.insert.styles contains responsive_image__insert_ri_demo2 (also set as the default insert style), the responsive insert style for the Responsive Image style 'insert_ri_demo2'.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is a Responsive Image style with id insert_ri_demo2, and the Article content type has an image field field_insert_ritask2 using the standard Image (image_image) widget with Insert already enabled. Using insert_responsive_image, make the responsive insert style for insert_ri_demo2 (responsive_image__insert_ri_demo2) available on that field's Insert settings. Keep the image_image widget and apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Add responsive_image__insert_ri_demo2 to the field_insert_ritask2 image_image component's third_party_settings.insert.styles in core.entity_form_display.node.article.default (the component already exists, so a single setComponent adding the style and save is enough; or tick 'Responsive: insert_ri_demo2' under Insert on the widget in Manage form display).
